items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I met Panama Francis in those years, years ago.

ctx.x: Who all can you remember from the jam

sessions at your house? Who used to play there? Well, let me see. As I mentioned, Panama Francis was one of the guys. Al Morgan, who's gone on, a marvelous bass player, used to be with Calloway years ago. And Al -- not Al Wilson -- Lloyd Wilson, who was a trumpet player from Detroit, he and his wife shared a house with us, and guys like Forest Powell, a little trumpet player who's also still around, and -- oh, gosh.
